description: Read the values out of a filled PDF form, labelled by field, with a completeness verdict when the form is known. Give the filled PDF (pdf_url: public https link, or pdf_base64) and, when you know it, form_id. Returns every form box in the file with its value and whether it is filled; when the form is recognised, each value also carries its label and whether it was required, plus a completeness verdict. Nothing is stored: read-back never keeps your file. Billed as one read; the first 5 each month are free. Pass dry_run=true to rehearse this call without doing it: nothing is stored, charged or sent, and no AI is used. The answer says whether the real call would succeed or be refused, what it would cost, and what a rehearsal cannot check.
name: read_form
title: Read a filled form back
